verdict.rationale: Gusto's official MCP server docs describe an OAuth2 connection flow in which the user selects which categories of data the chosen LLM can access, giving scoped, least-privilege credentials per agent connection. Supporting evidence covers distinct system access tokens and the CLI's separate sandbox/production credential slots with token injection for headless agents. Missing for 10: detail on scope granularity (read vs. write per resource), credential revocation/expiry controls for agent connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scoping.
